setup.eval: (async () => { const code = [...document.querySelectorAll('code')].map(c => c.textContent.trim()).find(t => /^\d{6}$/.test(t)); const input = document.querySelector('input[name=code]'); input.value = code; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Verify').click(); })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const until = async (f) => { const end = Date.now() + 20000; while (Date.now() < end) { const v = f(); if (v) return v; await sleep(200); } return null; }; await sleep(1200); if (!location.pathname.startsWith('/login')) return 'signed in'; const set = (n, v) => { const el = document.querySelector('input[name=' + n + ']'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; await until(() => document.querySelector('input[name=tenant]')); set('tenant', 'wings'); set('email', 'admin@wings.demo'); set('password', '${env:SD_DESK_PASSWORD}'); document.querySelector('form button[type=submit]').click(); const code = await until(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('code')].map((c) => c.textContent.trim()).find((t) => /^\d{6}$/.test(t))); set('code', code); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Verify').click(); await until(() => !location.pathname.startsWith('/login')); await sleep(800); location.assign('/admin/config'); await sleep(2500); return 'signed in again'; })()
